ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominance estimated at approximately 65-70% of surface area, with low-intensity dark gray/black mottling occupying remaining 30-35% concentrated at the base and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast dark gray mottling is clustered at the fluke base and along the continuous trailing edge. Contiguous dark patches are localized around the median notch. The internal lobe surfaces exhibit a sparse distribution of dark focal spots on a primary white background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximate interior angle of 55 degrees with deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased peak density observed on the distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves originating at the notch, transitioning to a sharp upward recurve (hooking) at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Left lobe: three distinct circular high-contrast clusters (barnacles) located in the mid-section. Right lobe: five circular clusters concentrated in two groups, one near the median notch and one near the lateral tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct horizontal linear pixel disruptions observed in the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple circular parasitic barnacles (Coronula type) are actively attached to the ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark vertical pigmentation 'bleed' extending from the median notch through the central axis toward the fluke peduncle.
